text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were estimated to be at the following levels currently, a week ago and a year ago, industry sources said.
All figures in thousands of tonnes:
Motor gasoline stocks rose despite departing cargoes, predominantly to the UK.
Naphtha inventories were up slightly as incoming cargoes outweighed departures to Germany.
Gas oil stocks increased with product from the former Soviet Union (FSU) and the United States. They are expected to rise in the lead-up to a possibly large IPE-related delivery.
Fuel oil inventories rose with VGO arrivals and cargoes from the FSU. Some product fed reasonable bunker demand.
Jet fuel stocks were up as material arrived to be blended with gas oil. -- Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5004
